Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with evidence for severe insulin resistance or a disorder associated with severe insulin resistance must meet all of the following criteria: Suspected severe insulin resistance, or a disorder associated with severe insulin resistance, as evidenced by one or more of the following: Hyperinsulinemia (i.e. fasting insulin >30microU/mL) - High insulin requirement (> 2 units per kg per day or > 200 units total per day) - Phenotypic features suggesting a defect in glucose/lipid metabolism: - Acanthosis nigricans - Lipodystrophy/abnormal fat distribution - Xanthomata - Fatty liver - Known or suspected mutations of the insulin receptor gene - Known or suspected autoantibodies to the insulin receptor - Age >= 6 months - Ability of subject or Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent document.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has type 2 diabetes (HbA1c 6.5-7.2%) but no evidence of hyperinsulinemia, insulin resistance phenotypes (e.g., acanthosis nigricans, lipodystrophy), or insulin receptor mutations. Age is 58 years (>=6 months), and informed consent is documented.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Family members of patients, above (either affected or unaffected) must meet all of the following criteria: Biological relatives of patients in category (1) in whom a genetic cause of insulin resistance is known or suspected. - Age >= 6 months - Ability of subject (and/or legal guardian, for minor subjects) to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed assent/consent document.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient's family history includes cardiovascular issues (father's sudden cardiac death), but no genetic cause of insulin resistance is documented. No family member is described in the patient profile.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 1 must meet all of the following criteria: - Ability of subject (and/or legal guardian, for minor subjects) to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed assent/consent document. - In good general health with no known active medical conditions as evidenced by medical history - Age >= 12 years
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has type 2 diabetes, hypercholesterolemia, and a history of myocardial infarctions, which disqualify him as a healthy control.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 2. Subjects from Cohort 1 may be included in Cohort 2 if they meet the following ADDITIONAL inclusion criteria: Fasting glucose <100 mg/dL - HbA1c <5.7% - Fasting triglycerides <150 mg/dL - Fasting insulin <30 mcU/mL - BMI <27 kg/m2 or <90th percentile for age/sex (whichever is lower)
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient's HbA1c is 6.5-7.2% (>=5.7%), and he has type 2 diabetes, which is excluded from Cohort 2.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with evidence for insulin resistance or a disorder associated with severe insulin resistance --none
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: This criterion applies to the patient group, but the patient does not meet the inclusion criteria for this group.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Family members of patients, above --Pregnant at the time of enrollment
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is not a family member of a patient with insulin resistance.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 1 - Current use of prescription or non-prescription medication. Certain exceptions are permitted, including topical medications, vitamins, and hormonal contraceptives. Other medications may be permitted at the discretion of the investigators.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is not a healthy control subject, so this criterion does not apply.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Recent (past 2 months) use of drugs or supplements that alter glucose or lipid metabolism (e.g. niacin, fish oil, red yeast rice)
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is not a healthy control subject, so this criterion does not apply.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: History of diabetes or abnormal glucose tolerance
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: This criterion applies to healthy control subjects, not the patient group.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Psychiatric or cognitive disorder that will, in the opinion of the investigators, limit the subject's ability to provide informed consent/assent, or to comply with study procedures
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has no documented psychiatric or cognitive disorder.
Patient is male and not pregnant/lactating.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 2. Subjects from Cohort 1 may NOT be included in Cohort 2 if they have any of the following ADDITIONAL exclusion criteria: Abnormal screening labs, including the following: - ALT or AST more than 1.5 times the upper limit of normal - Glycosuria - Clinically significant anemia - Low eGFR (<60 mL/min/1.73m2) - Any other abnormality that, in the opinion of the investigator, will increase risk to the subject from participation, or interfere with interpretation of study data
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is not a healthy control subject, so this criterion does not apply.

Recap: Patient has type 2 diabetes, hypercholesterolemia, and a history of cardiovascular disease. Does not meet inclusion criteria for severe insulin resistance, family members, or healthy controls. Excluded from all groups due to diabetes and lack of insulin resistance evidence.
